scenes: Who needs a heat warning before the public?
The hospitals. | A warning that reaches clinics early lets them add staff, | stock fluids and clear beds before the heat arrives.
After Ahmedabad’s heat plan prepared hospitals and warned the public, | an evaluation estimated about one thousand one hundred and ninety deaths a year were avoided.
Warn the clinics, then the streets.
